title: Integral derived pullback, completed tensor product and internal Hom
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring
$\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put
$A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$. For a scheme $W$ let
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_W$ be the completed
coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$,
$D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ the derived category of
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules, and
$\operatorname{Res}_n:D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$
restriction of scalars along $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}\twoheadrightarrow(A_{E,n})_W$
(exact, so applied termwise). For $K\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$
write $K_n=K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ for
the derived tensor product with the constant $(A_{E,n})_W$-module; the
reductions $A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$ induce maps
$\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}K_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_nK_n$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be
a morphism of schemes, with inverse image $f^{-1}$ on pro-etale sheaves, which
is exact and satisfies $f^{-1}(A_{E,n})_Y=(A_{E,n})_X$. Define, for
$K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and $M,N\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$,

$$
 Lf^*K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n f^{-1}(K_n),
 \qquad
 M\mathbin{\widehat\otimes}^L_{\mathcal O_E}N
 =R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n\bigl(M_n\otimes^L_{A_{E,n}}N_n\bigr),
 \qquad
 R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_E}(M,N)
 =R\mathcal Hom_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}}(M,N),
$$

where $f^{-1}$ is applied termwise to a representative of $K_n$ (which computes
the derived pullback $L(f_n)^*$ at level $n$), $R\varprojlim_n$ is the derived
limit, formed by the Roos triangle in $D(-_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, of the
inverse systems whose transition maps are induced by
$A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$, and the last functor is the derived
internal Hom of the ringed site $(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W})$,
computed with a K-injective resolution of $N$ in the category of all
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules. The first two are, respectively, the
pullback followed by derived completion and the completed tensor product of
Bhatt--Scholze.

source.place: Definition 3.4.10 (completed tensor product), Lemma 3.4.11 (R Hom into a complete object is complete), Lemma 6.5.9 (4) (pullback followed by completion); with literature/stacks-project/proetale.tex, Lemma 099N (5) (proetale-lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case: Lf^*_comp M = R lim Lf^*(M ⊗^L Λ/I^n))

mathlib_searches.results: no derived (homotopy) limit in any triangulated or derived category; the only completed coefficient sheaf is `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ellAdicSheaf` (AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/ElladicCohomology.lean:63), the sheaf of abelian groups U ↦ C(U, ℤ_ℓ), with no ring or module structure and no derived category of modules over it

`Functor.totalLeftDerived` (CategoryTheory/Functor/Derived/LeftDerived.lean:193), an abstract left derived functor along a localization, and `Functor.mapDerivedCategory` (Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean:36) for exact functors; nothing for completed pullback or completed tensor products
